Ensure that `XLMRobertaTestVocab.MULTILINGUAL_VOCAB`, `XLMRobertaTestVocab.MULTILINGUAL_SCORES`, and `XLMRobertaTestVocab.EXPECTED_TOKENS` are properly initialized and contain the expected data for the test cases.
The logger statement `logger.info(i);` is used to print the index of the text being processed. While this can be useful for debugging, it might not be necessary in a production environment or could be replaced with a more descriptive message if needed.
Consider adding comments to explain what each part of the test does, especially the loop and the assertions.

review_comment: could you extract all this into a resource file. Then this `XLMRobertaTestVocab` could read and parse from that file so that it is easily used by others. Having all this statically used fields seems overly heavy to me.
